references.title: Update to US referral and Fulfillment by Amazon fees
references.quote: We will reduce referral fees for apparel products priced below $20. For items priced under $15, we will decrease referral fees from 17% to 5%. For products priced between $15 and $20, we will decrease referral fees from 17% to 10%. Other referral fees will remain unchanged. These reduced fees will apply starting January 15, 2024.

conditions: Exact historical announcement wording: under $15 and between $15 and $20. Do not substitute current schedule boundaries.
evidence_details.linkage_reason: Same Amazon Clothing and Accessories referral fee concept; current value and current schedule boundaries are unchanged.

title: Apparel referral fee reduction for items under $20

references.title: Update to US referral and Fulfillment by Amazon fees
references.quote: We will introduce an inbound placement service fee for standard and Large Bulky-sized products to reflect our cost of distributing inventory to fulfillment centers close to customers. These fees will average $0.27 per unit for standard-sized products and $1.58 per unit for Large Bulky-sized products. We will give you the option to pay reduced fees or even no fee based upon whether you send your shipment to a single location or multiple locations. These fees will be effective starting March 1, 2024, and the fees will be charged 45 days after products are received.

evidence_details.scope: U.S. FBA standard and Large Bulky-sized products
conditions: Announced averages, not universal rates: about $0.27/unit for standard size and $1.58/unit for Large Bulky.
Lower or no fee if shipments go to multiple locations.
Charged 45 days after products are received.
evidence_details.linkage_reason: No existing current-record link; no prior value for this fee introduction.

references.title: Update to US referral and Fulfillment by Amazon fees
references.quote: We will introduce a low-inventory-level fee for standard-sized products. The fee applies if you carry consistently low levels of inventory relative to unit sales, as this inhibits our ability to distribute products across our network, degrading delivery speeds and increasing our shipping costs. Sellers can avoid this fee by maintaining more than four weeks of inventory relative to sales. These fees will apply starting April 1, 2024.

evidence_details.scope: U.S. FBA standard-sized products at introduction
conditions: Applies when inventory is consistently low relative to unit sales.
Avoided by keeping more than four weeks of inventory relative to sales.
No fee amount is stated in this announcement; current rates are separate.
evidence_details.linkage_reason: Same low-inventory-level fee concept as current record. Original standard-size introduction is distinct from current eligibility and Jan 15, 2026 current-rate timing.
